title: Drake: Billboard Hot 100 & Streaming Analytics
text: Welcome to the Drake music analytics project. This site analyzes Drake’s historic career through thousands of data points—combining over 2,500 weekly Billboard Hot 100 observations with modern track analytics from Songstats.

title: Drake: Billboard Hot 100 & Streaming Analytics
text:
Chart Trajectory Over Time
The scatter plot below displays every single weekly appearance by Drake on the Billboard Hot 100 between 2009 and 2021 (2,569 individual points). Each point represents a track’s position during a specific chart week, colored by whether Drake was the lead artist or a featured collaborator.

title: Drake: Billboard Hot 100 & Streaming Analytics
text:
Key Findings

Volume and Consistency: Across 2,569 chart entries, Drake maintained an unbroken presence on the Hot 100 spanning more than a decade (2009–2021).
Lead vs. Feature Dynamics: Early in his career (2009–2012), guest features (such as with Lil Wayne and Nicki Minaj) accelerated his exposure. By 2015–2018, Drake’s lead tracks dominated the upper echelon of the chart.
Chart Saturation: Major album release weeks (such as Scorpion in 2018 and Views in 2016) placed dozens of tracks simultaneously on the chart.
